# datagecko_stream_query_panels (Resource)

A stream's query panels, in order, replaced whole. A panel is a pointer to an action by name with fixed parameters, never a pre-authorization. Declare one per stream: two on one stream overwrite each other on every apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One datagecko_stream_query_panels per stream. Two on one stream overwrite each other on every apply.
resource "datagecko_stream_query_panels" "revenue" {
  stream_id = datagecko_stream.revenue.id

  panel {
    title      = "Top rows"
    action     = datagecko_action.rows.name
    parameters = jsonencode({ limit = 10 }) # `dt` is datagecko's to fill
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stream_id` (String) The stream whose list this is. A change replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `panel` (Block List) One panel; at most 8 per stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--panel))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The stream id: the import identifier.

<a id="nestedblock--panel"></a>
### Nested Schema for `panel`

Required:

- `action` (String) A declared action's name. Its existence is not checked.
- `title` (String)

Optional:

- `parameters` (String) Fixed parameters, at most 8 KB; never dt, which datagecko fills. A JSON object; write it with jsonencode().

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the stream's id: the list belongs to the stream.
terraform import datagecko_stream_query_panels.revenue 4f1c6a3e-...
```
